static_transition_append_source_audit.six_token_path: UnifiedNativeDecoder.decode chunks transition IDs by at most 8; a six-ID suffix reaches one forward_tokens([six IDs]) call. Server forwards that list as one worker.append_text_tokens call.
static_transition_append_source_audit.worker_geometry: _append_text_tokens sets logical_q_len=6 and physical_q=max(2, 6+(6&1))=6; UnifiedTokenAdapter.prepare yields embeddings [1,6,1536] and projected PLE [1,6,35,256].
static_transition_append_source_audit.native_abi: When the loaded DSO advertises BATCH_VARIABLE_Q_TEXT_CAPABILITY and exports gemma4_listener_batch_step_embedded_variable_async, step_async calls that symbol once with logical_q_len=6 and physical_q_len=6. Missing capability does not loop/fallback to Q1; it raises.
static_transition_append_source_audit.native_forward: C entrypoint validates logical Q3..8 / even physical Q4..8 then calls gemma4_listener_batch_step_core once with row_count=1/query_count=6. The core loops over model layers with Q6 activations and increments forward_calls once; it does not issue six Q1 native forwards.
static_transition_append_source_audit.max_q: logical max 8; physical max 8; odd logical Q is ceil-even padded. Q6 has no pad.
static_transition_append_source_audit.cpu_regression: tests/kernel/test_unified_kv_server_gate.py uses a six-ID transition and asserts one append tuple (3,4,5,6,7,8), followed by separate sampled-token appends. tests/kernel/test_unified_token_adapter.py covers variable logical Q6 shape.

implementation.evidence: Span-aligned estimates and a cumulative cursor are exercised on the production V1 LiveQwenSayStream path; ACK watermark advances only on released PCM and respects packet commit/generation/segment identity. No callback means no auto-ACK.
implementation.qwen_ingestion_boundary: consume_qwen_token tracks token ingestion/admission for FIFO pacing; ingestion does not acknowledge speech or advance the emitted-PCM watermark.
implementation.pcm_emission_boundary: ack_emitted_audio_frame advances after PCM is actually released by the emitter; a multi-frame PCM chunk can acknowledge every eligible frame, but buffered frames do not count.
implementation.commit_barrier: A PCM ACK for an uncommitted anticipated packet remains pending until the matching cursor/generation/segment commit; stale generation/segment identities are rejected.
implementation.span_estimator_contract: Strip token text; empty text gets one frame; count alphanumeric characters at weight 1 and punctuation at weight 2 for .?!;: or 1 otherwise; estimate max(1,min(6,round(weighted_count/1.15))). This is a timing heuristic, not phonetic alignment.
implementation.span_cursor_contract: One cumulative frame_spans cursor is shared by FiLM and FIFO; generation_step selects the current token span, and tail hold applies only after available token spans are exhausted. Frame 0 preservation remains enabled.
